description: Boundary records preserve shared predictions in the reconstruction, including repeated predictions of a restoration (engine §4.2 and §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%conditions $.ends-input ∨ ¬$.followed-by(Z)
%rule a (A [+T] y)
%rule b (A [+T] [+T] y)
%rule c (A [+T y] Z)
%rule y B
